Name: yuxiiqn's slightly edited abigail portrait - portraiture
Author: yuxiiqn
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]i altered [b]poltergeister[/b]'s [b]slightly edited portrait [/b]for abigail (the spring one from their seasonal outfits mod[b]) [/b]to fit a softer aesthetic. her colors are less saturated and contrasting and i also made some slight changes to the outfit and hair. [/color]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]the file includes two options: [b]portraiture[/b] or alternatively direct file replacement[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]portraiture: copy the "yuxiiqn" folder into the portraiture mod's folder[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]alternative file replacement: for if you're already using poltergeister's mod[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]go to their mod's folder: [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]folder -> assets. then replace abigail.png with the file inside the yuxiiqn folder[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]portraiture or slightly edited portraits[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size] [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]this is based off of poltergeister's abigail portrait!! [/color]
